# Generated evidence: eth/transfer

Written by `pnpm report eth/transfer --record` from `templates/eth/transfer/template.json`, `templates/eth/transfer/docs.json`, `registry/contracts.json`, `testdata/report/eth-transfer.json`, `testdata/abi`. The listings and pages were read on 2026-11-13. `pnpm test` computes it again from these files and fails on any difference: every section is recomputed from the recorded answers except the vault evidence, which is stored as `pnpm vault-evidence` printed it. The recordings were made on the AI's computer; `pnpm report eth/transfer --compare` reads the listings, pages, ABI proofs, code spans, ERC-7730 attestations and DefiLlama's protocol entries and hacks live, reads each vault again at the blocks its evidence names and each protocol fact and token's decimals at the block it was read at, fetches each recorded past transaction again by hash, and prints each fact that differs. It does not search for past transactions again, so it cannot show that a search found every one. Text from outside the program appears only as identifiers: a contract name Etherscan gives, printed only when it is a Solidity identifier, and the file paths, field paths and format names `pnpm erc7730` prints. The URLs come from the registry and `docs.json`, in RFC 3986 characters only. Text the AI wrote appears only where a row says it was written by the AI in the template. Do not edit this file.
